name: @veren/zhihu-client
description: Use when a feature must read Zhihu account and content data through the official Zhihu open platform: it holds the endpoint table in one place so upstream drift is a one-file edit, normalizes the platform's responses into stable canonical types (account snapshot, content refs, per-content stats, comments, hot list, answerable questions, quota), guards the free daily quota with a local call budget and a request-interval throttle, and reports failures as structured errors with stable codes; skip it when the deployment never talks to Zhihu.
